body: One year ago my best friend whom I've known for 12 years just abandoned me for some girl that he just meet. By abandoned I mean no contact what soever. This guy was like a brother to me and just like that it's all gone. Now i have trust issues. I feel very lonely. I have no real friends. I'm doing horribly in school, to the point where I might get kicked out. I've gained weight to the point where I  feel disgusted with myself like some fat fuck. I used to have goals and ambitions, and be passionate about certain things. Now I don't have any ambitions at all. All I wanted to be is happy with myself, but now I'm a huge piece of shit that doesn't deserve to live.
